pt <- prop.test(65, 500, p = 0.10, correct = FALSE)
z <- (65/500 - 0.10) / sqrt(0.10 * 0.90 / 500)
value <- c(X2 = unname(pt$statistic), z2 = z^2, p = pt$p.value, p_from_chisq = pchisq(z^2, 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
answer <- if (abs(value[1] - value[2]) < 1e-8 && abs(value[3] - value[4]) < 1e-10) "B" else "A"
answers.note: Checks that X-squared equals z^2 and that the p-value is the upper chi-squared(1) tail.
